title: Book Lovers
author: Emily Henry
summary: Nora, a sharp literary agent in New York, is dragged on a sisters' trip to a small North Carolina town, where she keeps running into Charlie, a book editor she once clashed with in the city.
readIf: you want a clever, bookish romance that plays with the usual small-town romance tropes.
skipIf: you'd rather have a heroine who doesn't push everyone away or a conflict-free story.

pairings.reason: Another Emily Henry romance with banter, travel and a long friendship turning into more.
Another workplace-rivals romance with sharp dialogue.
Another novel about writers whose attraction helps and hinders their work.
